- "As of 7:16 AM EDT Tuesday"
- "Sunday 1:00 PM EDT game"
- "7:14 AM EDT Tuesday", "7:13 AM EDT" and "7:15 AM and 7:14 AM EDT"
- "7:11 PM EDT Monday"
- "1:00 PM EDT Sunday kickoff"
All must read EST.

- "none of which had been confirmed in our materials as of Tuesday morning" should say what had not been announced as of 7:16 AM EST Tuesday.
- "the reporting we reviewed did not say" should be restated the same way.
